related.title: Rust：所有權、借用與生命週期
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付queue-trace.csv與順序斷言；不把零毫秒timer稱為立即執行。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver queue-trace.csv and order assertions; a zero-delay timer is not immediate execution. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 畫owner、兩shared references與scope；另畫clone的獨立allocation，區分move及copy。
related.differenceEn: Draw owner, two shared references and scopes, then an independent clone allocation; distinguish move from copy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
同步程式先完成，microtask checkpoint再處理排隊工作；timer延遲不是精確排程保證。
本課數值核對：2+1+1 = 4 log_entries；另一項核對：2+1 = 3 B_position。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

借用規則限制同時存在的可變及共享存取；生命週期表達參照有效範圍，不是執行期倒數計時。
本課數值核對：4*4 = 16 B；另一項核對：2*4*4 = 32 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Synchronous code finishes before a microtask checkpoint processes queued work; timer delay is not an exact scheduling guarantee.
Numeric audit: 2+1+1 = 4 log_entries; second audit: 2+1 = 3 B_position. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Borrowing constrains simultaneous mutable and shared accesses; lifetimes express reference validity, not runtime countdowns.
Numeric audit: 4*4 = 16 B; second audit: 2*4*4 = 32 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: WebAssembly：線性記憶體與界限 trap
related.titleEn: WebAssembly: linear memory and bounds traps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付queue-trace.csv與順序斷言；不把零毫秒timer稱為立即執行。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver queue-trace.csv and order assertions; a zero-delay timer is not immediate execution. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 用半開區間[offset,offset+width)測邊界，區分記憶體增長與普通store；記錄little-endian解碼。
related.differenceEn: Test half-open[offset,offset+width), distinguish memory growth from store and record little-endian decoding.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
同步程式先完成，microtask checkpoint再處理排隊工作；timer延遲不是精確排程保證。
本課數值核對：2+1+1 = 4 log_entries；另一項核對：2+1 = 3 B_position。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

線性記憶體有明確位元組界限；load/store需整段在範圍內，越界會trap而非自動延伸。
本課數值核對：65532+4 = 65536 end_address；另一項核對：65533+4-65536 = 1 overflow_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Synchronous code finishes before a microtask checkpoint processes queued work; timer delay is not an exact scheduling guarantee.
Numeric audit: 2+1+1 = 4 log_entries; second audit: 2+1 = 3 B_position. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Linear memory has explicit byte bounds; an entire load/store must lie inside, and out-of-bounds access traps rather than extending memory.
Numeric audit: 65532+4 = 65536 end_address; second audit: 65533+4-65536 = 1 overflow_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
